coverage_limits: SRC:237 reports a notice dated October 5, 1959 preceding a December 25, 1954 suit; chronology is inconsistent.
Lower appeal found rent acceptance with knowledge of subletting (SRC:173), but High Court and Supreme Court reject evidentiary sufficiency (SRC:175, SRC:181).
May 1954 marks end of Association publishing arrangement, not proven first knowledge of subtenancy; no rent accepted since 1954 (SRC:260, SRC:266-267).
Sarkar dissented on 1958 Act applicability, but agreed with majority on absence of acquiescence and independent appeal (SRC:178-181, SRC:345-350).
Judgment recites trial decree but does not reproduce standalone original decree instrument (SRC:242, SRC:270).
